settings.content: Upload the logo files here and they appear in the header, the footer, the browser tab and every link preview. Until then the site draws the GBG wordmark in type, in the brand colours.

settings.label: Logo (white version, for the navy footer)
settings.info: Optional. Without it the footer draws the wordmark in white instead.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Square. A 512 x 512 PNG of the arrow mark works best; Shopify resizes it for every device.

settings.label: Default share image
settings.info: Shown when someone shares a link on WhatsApp, TikTok or Facebook and the page has no image of its own. 1200 x 630 works everywhere.

settings.content: The GBG palette from the brand identity: navy and amber, on white, with black ink for type. Choose which of the two leads on buttons and links below.

settings.label: Lead colour for buttons and links
settings.info: Navy reads as authority and is the safer default. Amber is louder and pushes harder on calls to action.

settings.content: These links are pulled from a single setting everywhere they're used sitewide - update once here and every WhatsApp button, SYPB link and Wholesale Hub link on the site updates together.

settings.label: WhatsApp message link (direct to Lami)
settings.info: Used for every "message us" button, including the floating button. This is a one to one chat, not a group.

settings.label: SYPB community link
settings.info: The Start Your Product Business WhatsApp group. Used by every SYPB button on the site.

settings.label: SYPB video link
settings.info: The video new members are told to watch before they join. Leave blank and the "watch the video" buttons fall back to the SYPB group link.

settings.label: GBG Wholesale Hub community link
settings.info: The buyers-only WhatsApp group. Shown on the order and account pages once a customer has bought.

settings.label: Restock day
settings.info: Confirm with Lami: the actual weekly restock day.

settings.label: Hero stat: dispatch
settings.default: Ships from the UK in 3 days

settings.label: Starter Box minimum price (number only, in pounds)
settings.info: Used in the FAQ and on the Start Here page.

settings.label: Dispatch and delivery timeframe
settings.info: Shown on product pages, in the cart, in the FAQ and in the footer. Change it here and it changes everywhere.
settings.default: Ships from the UK. Standard delivery is 3 working days.

settings.label: Warehouse location
settings.info: Used in the FAQ and in structured data.

settings.label: Next SYPB live session
settings.info: Optional. Leave blank and the site says sessions are announced inside the group.

settings.label: Support email
settings.info: Confirm with Lami: the live support inbox.

settings.label: Response time promise
settings.default: Within 24 hours everyday except Fridays and Sundays - those are our rest days.

settings.label: Founder's note (About page + order confirmation)
settings.info: Launch-ready copy written in Lami's voice. Confirm the final wording with her.
settings.default: GBG started because I got tired of watching women give up on reselling, not because they weren't capable, but because nobody could give them a straight answer without gatekeeping. I built this to be the source I needed when I started: real stock, honest prices, and someone who actually answers when you ask a question. Every part of this hub - the shop, the guides, the community - comes from that same place. Thank you for being part of it.

settings.label: Address line (structured data)
settings.info: Confirm with Lami: the registered / warehouse address.

settings.label: City / locality
settings.info: Confirm with Lami: the city or locality.

settings.label: Postal code
settings.info: Confirm with Lami: the postal code.

settings.content: Storefront tracking. Paste an ID and the tag goes live; leave it blank and nothing is loaded. Shopify's own analytics needs no setup. Checkout and purchase events are NOT covered here, because Shopify blocks third-party scripts on checkout: add those in Settings > Customer events, or by installing the Google and TikTok sales channels.

settings.label: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID
settings.info: Looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX. Found in GA4 under Admin > Data streams.

settings.label: Google Search Console verification code
settings.info: Only the content value from the HTML tag method, not the whole tag.

settings.label: TikTok pixel ID
settings.info: Found in TikTok Ads Manager under Assets > Events > Web events. Installing the TikTok sales channel instead is the better route, because it also covers checkout.

settings.label: Meta (Facebook) pixel ID
settings.info: Optional. Leave blank if you are not running Meta ads.
